tagline: Funda kuzo zonke izilimi. Hlala ungasindi.
selectionHint: Khetha igama, umusho, noma isigaba. Ungakwazi futhi ukuchofoza kwesokudla.
appHint: Ukuhumusha kwesixhumi esibonakalayo kuhlanganiswe ngokungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi. Ezinye zihunyushwe ngomshini. Amagama olimi alandela ulimi lohlelo lokusebenza olukhethiwe.
fallback: Uma i-Bing yehluleka, zama i-Google (ithumela umbhalo ku-Google)
dynamicHint: Okuqukethwe okubonakalayo kubekwa phambili. Misa ukukhipha izibukeli.
hide: Fihla kuze kube yilapho ikhasi liqala kabusha
languageReset: Ulimi lwangaphambilini alutholakali kule njini; ukukhetha kolimi kubuyekeziwe.
message1: Ikhodi yolimi ayivumelekile. Sebenzisa i-id, en, ja, zh-CN, njalo njalo.
message5: - Imikhawulo yesidingo/isilinganiso. Zama futhi emuva kwesikhathi.
message6: Umhlinzeki akabuyiseli okuhunyushiwe. Hlola imodeli, ulimi, kanye nesabelo.
message12: Umbhalo ongenalutho noma izinhlamvu ezingaphezu kuka-12,000.
message34: Umhlinzeki ushintsha ifomethi yomaka. Ibhulokhi yokuqala iyagcinwa.
message38: Omaka abekho emiphumeleni. Ibhulokhi yokuqala iyagcinwa.
message44: Umhlinzeki wehlulekile kumaqoqo angu-3. Chofoza ukuhumusha ukuze uzame futhi.
message49: Umkhawulo wenkumbulo yokuqukethwe ufinyelelwe. Buyisela ikhasi ngaphambi kokuqhubeka.
message58: Layisha kabusha isandiso bese uvuselela ikhasi ukuze ulayishe inguqulo entsha.
message61: Vuselela ikhasi uma isandiso esisha sibuyekezwa.
message65: Fihla kuze kube yilapho ikhasi liqala kabusha
